verdict.rationale: Trello is a SaaS work-management product with a public REST API, Power-Ups and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test tenant, or isolated non-production environment. Building Power-Ups on your own boards, or using the free plan for a throwaway board, would only be user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
